title: Quarterly roadmap: Private & On‑Prem integration lattice and risk‑weighted milestones
creator: Ava Lin
description: Objective: Deliver a sequenced, risk-weighted quarterly roadmap that aligns Private (VPC) and On‑Prem delivery lanes with SLAs, upgrade windows, and pilot cohorts for regulated customers. This ticket captures the cross-functional initiative lattice (dependencies + fallbacks), milestone hedging, acceptance gates, and telemetry signals we will use to monitor rollout health.
plan_summary: 1) Define three milestone tiers (Alpha pilot, Beta cohort, General availability) with acceptance gates tied to SLO compliance, upgrade success rate, and rollbackability. 2) Produce a dependency lattice mapping runtime, installer, networking, RBAC, KMS, and ops-playbook deliverables. 3) Reserve two pilot customers from fintech and healthcare cohorts for staged activation. 4) Harden observability and gating metrics in Console (per-tenant telemetry, token-cost delta, tail-latency 99.9th pctl).
milestones: M1: Alpha pilot build + onprem installer prototype (2026-03-28)
M2: VPC private control plane hardened with RBAC & KMS integration (2026-04-11)
M3: Canary upgrades + rollback test across 3 sandbox tenants (2026-04-25)
M4: Beta cohort activation (5 customers) + telemetry SLA verification (2026-05-12)
M5: GA readiness sign-off & runbook publish (2026-05-30)
acceptance_criteria: Automated upgrade success >= 98% across canary tenants
Per-tenant latency SLO (p99) degradation <= 15% compared to baseline
KMS key rotation test completes without failed calls in 3 attempts
Audit log retention for onprem installs validated in two customer environments
Runbook includes rollback, data-migration checklists, and emergency contacts
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Installer edge-case failures on RHEL variants -> Mitigation: allocate ENG-20567 task + run preflight image validation suite
Risk: Network ACLs block control plane callbacks for private installs -> Mitigation: document minimal egress ports and provide NAT/Proxy fallback pattern
Risk: Pilot customer legal/compliance delays -> Mitigation: early SOW draft and dedicated SE for legal kickoff
Risk: Observability gaps for tenant-level token cost -> Mitigation: short spike to instrument Console traces and surface token-breakdown metrics before Beta
related_prs_and_tasks: ENG-19204 (runtime: KV-cache eviction improvements for multi-tenant onprem)
success_metrics: Pilot activation time (first request to healthy) < 4 hours
Customer-reported SLO breaches = 0 in first 14 days post-activation
Post-GA churn within tranche < 2% in first 90 days
communication_plan: Weekly cross-functional syncs (PM/ENG/DES/Reliability/SE) on Wednesdays; biweekly stakeholder summary to GTM and Legal. Use #private-rollouts Slack channel for realtime escalations; escalate to execs if L2 incident persists beyond 2 hours during pilot.
